description.rationale: Description is metadata only and does not affect any security controls.

disabled.description: Whether this exclusion rule should be disabled or not. This defaults to false.
disabled.rationale: If disabled is set to false (default), the exclusion actively filters out logs at the organization level. Security-critical logs should never be excluded as it creates organization-wide blind spots for security monitoring and incident response.

filter.description: The filter to apply when excluding logs. Only log entries that match the filter are excluded.
filter.rationale: The filter determines which logs are excluded at the organization level. Excluding security-relevant logs (audit logs, high severity logs, IAM changes) creates critical organization-wide security blind spots and violates CIS GCP Benchmark requirements. Organization-level exclusions affect ALL projects under the organization.

name.description: The name of the logging exclusion.
name.rationale: Name is a unique identifier for the exclusion filter. It has no security implications beyond being a reference name.

org_id.description: The organization to create the exclusion in.
org_id.rationale: This identifies which organization owns the exclusion filter. It has no direct security impact on the exclusion's behavior.
